open_points.subject: REGISTRY_BASE_URL configuration lifecycle
open_points.text: A30 now says “REGISTRY_BASE_URL is read by the Registry gateway at each call, not at start-up,” while State 1 names “RuntimeSettings and RuntimeEnvironment — the startup configuration ... read from the environment,” and A30 still says config.runtime_environment_variables is “read into RuntimeSettings.”
open_points.question: Is REGISTRY_BASE_URL excluded from the startup RuntimeSettings snapshot and fetched directly from the environment for every Registry gateway call, including after the environment changes?
options: Exclude it from RuntimeSettings and read the current environment value on every gateway call
Capture it in RuntimeSettings at startup and use that fixed value
Keep it in RuntimeSettings but ignore that field and also read the live environment value
open_points.default_guess: Exclude it from RuntimeSettings and read the live environment value on every Registry gateway call, following the changed normative sentence.

witness.initial: The service starts while REGISTRY_BASE_URL is https://registry-a.example.
events: The host operator changes REGISTRY_BASE_URL to https://registry-b.example without restarting the service.
A staff member performs a project operation that calls Registry.
outcomes: A gateway implementing the new per-call rule calls registry-b.example.
A gateway built from startup RuntimeSettings calls registry-a.example.
witness.observer: The staff member and host operator see which Registry supplies the result.

open_points.subject: Startup validation of REGISTRY_BASE_URL
open_points.text: A30 now says REGISTRY_BASE_URL “is no required start-up variable, and its absence fails only Registry calls,” but R0-10 says the service is configured by environment variables “which it validates when it starts.”
open_points.question: Must the general startup-validation rule explicitly exempt an absent REGISTRY_BASE_URL so startup succeeds, or does startup validation still refuse the deployment?
options: Startup succeeds without REGISTRY_BASE_URL; only a later Registry call fails with transport_error
Startup refuses because a configured environment variable is missing
Startup succeeds only in selected runtime environments according to the carried requiredness table
open_points.default_guess: Startup succeeds and each attempted Registry call fails with transport_error, following changed A30 and A6.

witness.initial: A deployment has every otherwise required environment variable but no REGISTRY_BASE_URL.
events: The host operator starts the service.
An authenticated user later invokes an operation requiring Registry validation.
outcomes: Under changed A30, startup and liveness succeed; the later Registry operation fails with transport_error.
Under R0-10's unqualified startup-validation rule, startup is refused and neither request can be served.
witness.observer: The host operator, monitor, and authenticated user see the difference.
